title: Logozusatz / Vertical centered

location.series: DB new design / original GIF demonstrations

slide_intent: Stack the sender and descriptor when a vertical arrangement supports recognition in the available space.
strategic_value: A centered two-level lockup can retain DB identity in a narrower composition.
demonstration: The red DB logo resolves above the black Zusatz descriptor; both remain centered on the pale field.
practical_value: Compare the stacked signature with horizontal alternatives before choosing an orientation.

content_islands.name: Stacked lockup
content_islands.spec: Place the red mark above the descriptor and align their centers.

content_islands.name: Business descriptor
content_islands.spec: Keep the black Zusatz text subordinate to the DB mark and reveal it after the mark.

reference_purposes.Application: The source presents this arrangement as a business/product suffix variant.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The accompanying text permits the suffix when communication relates exclusively to a particular business or product area.
